text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 tree-cover loss claim. The evidence shows a 0.7 ha loss within the asset, confirmed by Hansen/UMD data and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference map, which agrees with 100% of the event area. The loss was observed in a later year (2025) and meets the minimum event size (0.5 ha). However, the JRC map alone doesn’t specify the cause, legality, or responsible party—it only confirms the loss occurred in a forested area as of 2020.
